requirements.title: Children's Anger Ebook Writing
requirements.definition: Produce the commissioned ebook text about understanding and managing anger in children, informed by the client's supplied themes on anger signals, management strategies, acceptable behavior, and adult support.
requirements.boundary_note: The four topical clusters in the outline are coverage areas within one commissioned ebook-writing deliverable; the evidence does not show them being commissioned, modified, or cancelled independently.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client calls the supplied outline 'insights,' so the evidence does not establish whether every listed bullet was mandatory coverage or advisory source material.
